correctness.rationale: Exact O(n)-invariant covariance on the (n-1)(n+2)/2-dimensional traceless symmetric module gives K(P,Q)=nD_n/[k(n-k)](tr(PQ)-k^2/n). Averaging arbitrary bounded projections and using the O(k)xO(n-k) stabilizer-fixed one-dimensional line proves least norm. Haar corner block squared norm converges by Jiang Theorem 1 to chi-square(k^2); exact second moments establish uniform integrability. Gamma integration gives c_k; the digamma-coth integral is positive for s>0, showing strict hierarchy, and Stirling supplies the 1/sqrt(pi) limit. Reconstructed the key n=2,k=1 beta boundary and independent mpmath gamma values k=1..20 confirmed strict sampled order (not an infinite proof). The normal block TV approximation truly requires k=o(sqrt n), matching hypotheses.
